body: I used to listen to coffee shop sounds to get me in the right headspace for writing and reading but this is much more effective. I find this really helpful for getting things done, as I have a hard time focusing otherwise. I am very sensitive to sounds while I work and can’t be productive with anything that has a melody or lyrics. This is perfect and I know I’ll continue to use it a lot.
author: K. Dessavre

title: Really Works
body:
I mainly use the Focus to help with studying, work, and even cleaning the house! I really do experience a difference when listening to brain fm as opposed to silence. My mind wonders off way less and I’m able to stay on task for much longer. So much more productive.

I rarely use the sleep one. I don’t think it helps me very much, but maybe I’ve just had the volume a little to high?

I should use relax and meditation more often. I just don’t make time to. But the couple times I have, I reached such a surprising state of calm- I’m a very high strung, hyper person, so it was a big deal. I should use those more often. 

But I love Focus. The main focus music (the one that appears red) seems to work the best for me for the reason, but the “more focus music” towards the right helps a lot too. I bought the 1 year and it’s worth it.
author: Nikia2

title: Focus is so helpful
body: I have been using the focus feature at work to drown out my coworkers and the constant office noise. It works and I’m able to be very productive.
author: Scarlett.Letters

title: Works, but ugly.
body: Needs a UI/UX overhaul.  The power of this music is held back by a rather amateur design.
author: rplusj

title: Worst App Ever — Total Rip-off
body: I tried this app before deciding to pay for a subscription. I work from home so the idea of listening to music that will help me focus was very exciting. As soon as I became a paid subscriber the connectivity issues became evident. You cannot listen to a single track without the signal dropping on you every few minutes. Which defeats the whole premise of BrainFM. It is impossible to focus with the constant connectivity issues . It’s horrible, I wish I could get my money back. I would not recommend this app to my worst enemy...on a second thought, maybe I would recommend it to my worst enemy that is how horrible the app is, you can use it as a weapon of mass distraction & frustration against your enemies. I want my money back!
author: belathar

title: Awesome
body: One of the best purchases EVER. I heard of them through MINDPUMP. Tried them out. For one who has trouble focusing, trouble sleeping, trouble letting go of the days stress with work or what have you. Brain FM has changed my life. Really has!!!! The focus sessions have really been helpful, the meditation, and recharge as well. Try it you will love it!!!!!
author: autmwind69

title: No issues
body: I have been using Brain app for a year. I have had no issues. I think it is great.
author: ChazPhilip

title: Lifesaver
body: I use the Sleep, Relax, Focus, all of it! And you can download the ones you like so that a) you aren't using up data and b) you don't have to be connected to use the app. I bought a Lifetime and have never regretted it. I use this app daily in my life. It's the only app I can use while sleeping that actually helps me sleep. This is the best of this type of product out there, hands down. And they keep improving it.
author: AstroGirlBunny

title: Relax
body: This app helps me go to sleep concentrate an relax this can help you do any thing
author: creative destruction player

title: Support this company!
body: I throw them on at night with some quality headphones and a good book. I just tap the relax track and that's literally all the thought that's nessarry. It's really nice to have these types of tracks curated for me. Big thumbs up.
author: HulkBrain

title: I'm now a productivity machine...
body: When they say it takes about 10 minutes to kick in they're not kidding. Sit me down with a 2 hour FOCUS track and in minutes I'm crushing out my Highest quality work with ZERO distraction. Absolutely amazing. My monthly payment to Brain.fm has a very high ROI.
author: jfbuildstuff

title: This WORKS.
body:
I use the “focus” music and it legitimately helps. A lot.

Really cool app / service!!
author: richardsonjj36

title: Cancellation
body:
I don’t recommend this app, because there is no way to cancel it. 

The terms and conditions say to go to Account Overview (no such menu option exists) and select Cancel My Membership. None of that is possible in the app and there are no such options?

So I finally clicked on my subscription type and it says “yeah, you are on a subscription plan” or something like that. It then says if you would like to cancel, we can’t tell how you purchased your subscription, so contact our customer support. This brings up a “feedback” window? No form, no request for any info.

I don’t respect any business that makes cancellation this difficult. It’s shady. Sadly, I enjoyed the app. However I’m not down with their method of running a business. 

Let’s see if my “feedback” can get my subscription cancelled.
author: Blueglaze

title: The Focus setting really helps me work
body: I am a small business owner and work from home. Sometimes it is hard to get in the zone at home, but the Focus sounds really help me concentrate for 2-5 hours at a time! I upgraded to the paid subscription this year and really like it. I don’t use headphones, but a good quality Bluetooth speaker on the desk behind me.
author: Tammy Ann

title: Really helps me stay productive
body:
I have to say that I use brain.fm almost every day. I have ADHD and I have a hard time focusing even with medication. I subscribed to brain.fm when it was still in beta and I have to say that I love it! It helps me focus and really boosts my productivity for any intense non menial task. As a programmer it’s been an invaluable tool for me and I don’t know what I would do if this service ever went away.

Also, to anyone having issues with the app in the past or reading other reviews about that: in most recent versions it appears most of not all issues have been fixed. Please give it another try!
author: svanderbeek12

title: It works for me
body: The focus music does seem to help (I love the atmospheric selection) and I really enjoy the meditation songs.  My only complaint is that I can’t buy tracks outright.
author: CloutiusMaximus

title: Love product/miss guided meditation tho
body:
When I updated I lost guided meditation!
Still great tho
author: Panietzer

title: Great app
body: This app is great for my focus at work and in the gym. Relax really helps me unwind at the end of a long day. Sleep is the real game changer though!
author: acsmith141

title: Skips constantly !!! AVOID
body: What else to say. It skips constantly. I am paying for music and it's not music-- it's skipping music. What a scam. FIX IT OR SHUT DOWN PRODUCT. I have perfect 4G signal in Manhattan. Reinstalled. Closed. Reset. No luck.
author: Ioidjdjdjdkdisj

title: Helps for focus
body: I turn this on when I’m doing paperwork or design tasks and it helps calm the brain chatter so I can just work on one thing without distractions.
author: Bronco time

title: Thanks Brain.com
body: I love this app. It puts me to sleep and that’s a good thing 💤
author: tpapete

title: Paid subscriber— love it for work
body:
I use the focus playlist for work and knock out tasks in record time (which is key since I set my own schedule and clients pay me to produce!). 

Haven’t tried any of the other playlists yet (only reason I’m giving it 4 stars), so I can’t comment as to their effectiveness, BUT if they’re crafted with the same care as the Focus tracks, I’m sure they are superb. 

Tried the trial after a colleague recommended this for productivity and haven’t looked back since. I’ve recommended it to dozens of colleagues and they love it too. Definitely do try— with the trial option, you’ve got nothing to lose and only oodles of your time and productivity to reclaim!
author: Penelope Drake

title: Great!
body: I have very much enjoyed this app! I really love the focus sessions and use them anytime I study. Whenever I am tired and need to close my eyes for a minute I turn on the 15 min relax session and it works perfectly. When I first started using they had a guided and unguided meditation session. I really enjoyed the guided meditation(since I’ve never tried it before), but it has since disappeared. So that is why I gave it 4 stars, I loved that feature and I am bummed it is gone. But I highly recommend this app!
author: DannyGFergy

title: I find it effective
body: Both for work and relaxation.

title: All the songs are depressing
body: These songs are straight up sad. All in minor key and mad at their parents.
author: republicratarian

title: Focus-Relax-Focus
body:
Love Brain.FM!!  Bought lifetime subscription to the service since I use it constantly. The Grooves focus track is my fave!  

When I'm in the heat of the day, I will also use the Relax & Recharge channels for 30-60 minutes then put in more work well into the evening using a variety of Focus tracks. 

Thanks for the awesome service guys!!
author: GoRedWings2014

title: Wish I had found it sooner
body: I love this app , my sleep and focus during work is profoundly better. I use an oura ring and after going a week without brain.fm I can see the effect on quality of sleep
author: WhittierPc

title: Amazing Product
body: We use this product everyday.  I use guided meditation and focus.  My son uses the sleep app to calm his mind.  It’s a game changer.
author: ShaqFan1o1

title: Rough Start but Now Amazing
body: I’m a paid subscriber and the subscription is absolutely worth it. I have adult ADHD and being able to turn on focus was super hard for me. Using Brain FM has given me a tool that allows me to turn on some pleasant sounds or music. They now have a large variety of channels that could be better used to fit the listeners mood. Recently channels like Piano and Grooves were added and both really changed how I listened to the service. I use both web and mobile applications. In the earlier days, the mobile was lagging behind but in the last 6 months, the mobile is very much on par with the web. I genuinely like this service and I’ll keep paying for it. It has really helped me focus on my tasks or relaxes me through the meditation.  Totally worth it.
author: hank thornbug

title: Lifesaver for sleep
body: I use this app every night when I’m going to bed. I love that I can turn my phone onto airplane mode but still listen (download the track and use on offline mode).
author: Shakemybonbon

title: Good, but some connectivity issues
body: I love this app, especially the focus tracks. I use them to help me focus while studying and nothing works better for me... as others have mentioned, there are occasional connectivity issues, but overall it has been a lifesaver!
author: Tokeefe

title: Great background music to focus!
body: Listen to this app prob 20-30 hours a week. I love subtle background music. Works for me!
author: mmmatt!

title: Works for me
body: I’m a subscriber in my 50s. My life is marked by focus issues from early childhood. These days I manage it with diet, exercise, spiritual practice, and nootropic supplements. Nootropics are worthless if you don’t get solid sleep by the way.  Still, as a software engineer, most days are a struggle. This gives me a solid 2 to 3 hours of flow every day that I hadn’t been able to achieve before. Worth every penny, and I stopped taking the supplements.
author: adam silverton

title: Great app.
body: I use this app for so many reasons; focus while I’m working, meditation, when I just need to slow down and sometimes for sleep. I am a massage therapist and use it for clients as well. I really like the new content.  The yearly subscription is very affordable.  I have never had any problems with downloading content like some of the others have mentioned.
author: LangLisa

title: Pretty good
body: Very good
author: Galimk

title: Unbelievably good
body:
I've been using the online version for a few months and it has helped me in several areas. I'm a writer, and the "Focus" mode has helped me achieve higher word counts with less apparent effort. The guided meditations are very helpful as is the sleep mode. I've recommended this to many people and will continue to.
Edit August 4, ‘18. 
Still love this app. I use the meditation daily. I had tired of the driving, melody-free beat of the old “Focus” mode, but the new music is WONDERFUL! Yes, all I want is something pleasant in the background I can ignore, but pleasant matters! And it WORKS. If I’m tired or distracted, Brain.fm is my lifesaver. Thank you.
author: Ivy Childe

title: Productivity +++
body: I use brain.fm when I’m working and meditating, (hoping for workout tracks soon to boost performance). It, without a doubt, every time I use it, helps me block out distractions, gain momentum and ultimately cross of things on my to do list like it’s my job!
author: RyanClark8525

title: So much potential
body:
Amazing product overall with brilliant functionality online but there’s just no good reason why the app has so many issues.  After reviewing other responses it appears that they are well aware of the fact that the app will stop playing the selected music whether streaming or if it’s downloaded.  In the offline portion of the app it frequently switches between whichever songs you’ve downloaded or just stops playing altogether with no apparent rhyme or reason. 

They usually ask for more info to get to the bottom of the issue but after so many clear concerns with the same problems you’d think they’d get it together.  Not sure if they have enough support staff to actually handle the issue yet but I hope they can figure it out.  I know it’s probably more complicated than it seems but I’ve never had issues like this with any other paid app that’s been around for a while.  Very disappointed but hopeful.
author: Seen-Yor

title: Guided Meditation eliminated suddenly
body: One of the main features of this app was the guided meditation which allowed beginners looking to learn the art of mindfulness to lose the fear and have a step-by-step guide was suddenly comply eliminated.  Feedback was not acknowledged and it seems that once you sign up and pay in advance you don’t seem to exist to the developers. Truly disappointing personally since that small function in this app was having a big impact in my life.
author: Daniel Piz

title: A part of my GSD stack
body: When I want to get something done, I turn to Brain.Fm. When combined with good nutrition and sleep, I feel unstoppable.
author: Boomer Anderson

title: I enjoy using this app....still has room for improvement
body:
Received a 1 year paid subscription as a gift. I like that I can download tracks for offline listening and adjust the duration of listening tim. 
I want to use guided meditation more but cannot get to a quiet space in my head and body with that awful voice narration.  I read a review where someone said the music overpowered the man’s voice and to adjust the volume so the guiding voice is audible. 
I have the opposite experience. The voice is too loud, harsh, overpowering, NOT conducive to enabling a meditative state. Also, when listening to the new tracks - groove focus and piano, I cannot see the top of the screen to press the menu in the corner to go back to the main screen. It’s very very faint in the background .
author: annabananaWIS

title: Really Awesome.
body: I love this app! I used to spend lots of interruptive time searching for soundtracks to listen to (I’m a network design engineer, so lots of diagrams and spreadsheets, which requires intense focus). Ever since I found this app a few days ago (from article on Engadget), I’ve been enjoying hours of focused work and I’ve never been so productive! A big thanks to the great minds that put this together, my brain thanks you!!!
author: deckhopper

title: Epic!
body: I don’t sleep anymore without using this app. It has the power to stop my busy mind and that is something I have been unable to do my whole life
author: Zack Belknap

title: Amazing app
body: Meditation and napping are two constants in my day to day life. What’s so great about this app is that the sounds created by brain.fm’s composers are engineered to put you into a specific state. Whether you need a quick power nap or if you have to focus in at work, brain.fm has got you covered.
author: HeyItsDavidK

title: Awesome!
body: This is what’s keeping me alive in college. Once I press play on a Grooves Focus session, I’m zoned in for the next 2 hours. I’m glad I purchased the lifetime subscription.
author: RobbyKing23

title: Service is Amazing, App is...
body: I’m usually not super into “productivity hacks” that claim to help you stay focused and work. I think most of it is snake oil for people who can’t muscle down and concentrate. Yet, recently, I’ve found it hard to concentrate myself, so I decided to give this a shot, and it seems to be working almost immediately! My only complaint is that the app uses space very poorly. It has weird scrolling glitches where more space is revealed on letting go then should, and the UI could be better thought out in general. Once that’s fixed though, I’d give this nothing but 5 stars!
author: LinkChef

title: Helps me focus!
body: I’ve had Brain.fm (paid subscription) for about a week and so far it’s worth every penny.  The “focus” music really does help me when I need to hunker down and be productive.  My only gripe is that texts can still pop up and interrupt the music while I’m working.
author: Drone Salesman

title: Love this app but...
body: I use this app daily. One area they are lacking is in the meditation category. There just isn't a lot of content there. It would be nice to use the meditation sounds/music and not think "I've heard this one before"
author: Meditations4569834

title: Best meditation app out there
body: While I mainly have this app for meditation purposes I do find the focus and recharge helpful. I have been a subscriber for quite sometime now I only wish they added more guided meditations but still I have a felt a HUGE benefit from this app. Mental clarity, relaxation, calmness and overall a better mental state. For the price you pay. I don’t think there is any app like it that compares!

title: Meditation
body: They use to have guided meditation which left you relaxed and happy. But it has now been removed. Too bad this was best part. There was nothing like it that I found. Good things should not change.
author: k93101

title: Very helpful
body:
I really enjoy this app a lot. I use it for focus at work, for occasional afternoon naps, and for getting to sleep at night. It works for me as advertised. 

I have had very few issues with the app and the fairly regular updates and additional songs and moods keeps it interesting.
author: andrewwhichlivesinutah

title: Connectivity issues
body: Like others have mentioned, the stream is constantly disconnecting and i have to reopen the app to get the music playing again...Other than that i like the focus music while I'm working.
author: nbb789

It is definitely better than listening to classical music to focus.
author: Cameron 1997

body: I love Brain.fm but for some reason it tends to stop before the designated time is up. For example, this morning I selected 2 hours, but it paused 20 mins later. Otherwise would be a huge 5 stars!
author: MDR_RDM

title: My work soundtrack
body: When I want to get stuff done, I don the noise-canceling headset and use brain.fm’s Focus tracks.
author: sewmyheadon

title: This is the best brain-focusing app
body: I’ve tried a couple apps and this one by far gives me the most focus.
author: Karie Price

title: Very Useful
body: I very much enjoy the variety and focus the various programs have.  It is a true boon to both focus/work time and relaxation.  The meditation (especially guided) has even pulled me away from my beloved Calm app on several occasions.  Don’t forget to check out “More Music” on the right-hand menu (in my opinion the placement of this is not intuitive).  The Piano selections are particularly good.
author: MystikSpiral

title: One app to rule them
body: I used to have half a dozen white noise and iso beats apps. I got rid of the rest. This one does everything I want and the music is solid.
author: ReddHerring

title: Great sleep app with the right ear phones
body:
This was recommended by a successful senior leader in my company. We were sharing our favorite brain hacks for our own personal development. I am an experienced meditator and user of the Monroe instrument products. I thought this product wouldn't rate high for me. To my pleasant surprise Brain.fm won me over very fast. I quickly bought the annual subscription. 

My favorite brain.fm category at the moment is the sleep track as it has helped me once again sleep peacefully with my husband who snores loudly. With the sleep track I sleep 7- 8 hours without my normal 1 -2 times up for bathroom visits and my husbands snoring rarely wakes me. For comfort it is necessary to use specific sleep headphones such as the SleepPhones brand. I already purchased those for the Monroe audio products. 

Focus has helped me with productivity in an open concept office environment when my colleagues get too loud and distracting. I am looking forward to putting Brain.fm through the paces for meditation soon.

If you have trouble sleeping I would highly recommend this app and the paid service.
author: TelloyLinda

title: Life-Changing
body: If there is a heaven this is what it sounds like
author: noodley5

title: Music Level
body: Great App, but please take down the music you can’t hear the guy that’s guiding you through the meditation....way to loud. I find myself trying to here is voice but the music over powers him ....when trying to mediate that is not a good thing...So trying to find another app....

title: Poor Connectivity

author: MyHumbleReview

body: Like many others have experienced. My biggest issue with the app is the connectivity. Unless conditions are perfect, the stars, moons and planets are aligned the app crashes. Taking me out of focus or worse sleep. Great app when it works, though.
author: chudson125

title: Good overall, some connectivity issues
body: I really enjoy this app and find it quite useful. Occasionally, the app will open but no tracks will play. I would love to have tracks for exercise if an option.
author: Maybaby@68

title: Good for concentration
body: I’m a paid subscriber and I use the app when I’m writing. For me it is a great way to provide white noise, and helps me to concentrate on the task at hand. I adjust the timer to 30 minutes from the default setting of 2 hours because I like to move around every 30 minutes. I’m partial to the rain or thunder tracks.
author: Writer529

title: Really works for me.
body: I so rarely write reviews but this one is dear to me as it has helped so much. I am happy that this company has finally made the leap to the app world and it has been worth the wait. Keep up the good work guys.
author: cook34

title: Awesome app.
body: Really helps my sleep consistency
author: DennisElonka

title: Don’t fool yourself this is just music
body: There is nothing special about their music. When you listen to it you won’t be magically focused in 15 min. The sleep tracks actually make it harder for me to fall asleep. You can pull up study playlists on youtube for free if you want music to concentrate, this app offers nothing special. All the science saying it changes brainwaves is likely hogwash because I am sure if you hooked someones brain up while listening to any music it will cause a change in brainwaves. These people are selling snake oil and try to use scientific terms and “studies” to market plain ole music that isn’t even that good.
author: Stalking cow

title: Decent app, but developer has little integrity
body: The app works alright, but when you want to cancel your subscription they make it real difficult to do so.  Subscribing is super easy though, I wonder why 🤔.  Hate it when companies do this, it’s kind of criminal really, they must be desperate for money.  Subscribe at your own risk.  Still haven’t been able to cancel mine, hopefully I won’t have to jump through too many hoops to do so.
author: JustJames.

title: Fixed my trouble with focus!
body:
I’ve always struggled with getting distracted and procrastinating on important tasks.  Now, if I just turn on the Focus music, I’m magically in the mood to do deep work within a few minutes.  Love it!

The sleep music seems to be pretty effective as well :)
author: Johnnyskyfox

title: Great!
body: Great app..connectivity issues sometimes but i know they are working on getting that fix. I use it daily
author: wjvhouston

body: Brain.fm has a great thing going with the motivational sounds and music. I use it almost constantly. That being said, it’s totally aggravating to use the iOS app. Instead of being motivated or calm, I want to chuck my phone into a garbage disposal after attempting to use a calm session, only to have it stop every 30 seconds.
author: kofaco

title: Total game changer
body: Brain.fm has been a huge part in improving my productivity. I am able to keep my focus when working for much longer periods of time and as a result my business continues to grow. I highly recommend this product to combat the addiction to distraction that is growing so prevalent today.
author: ImBatDan

title: Not sure how it works, but it does...
body: I bought this for the Focus feature and hats pretty much all I use it for. I use Insight Timer for meditation and Brain.fm keeps me focused and moving at work. I’m a big fan and use it nearly every work day.
author: KungFuK

title: Too expensive
body: It’s ok and I use it for many things, but it should be a flat $7 fee instead of $7 a month. I get a service out of it but the price is very high. Will probably cancel subscription after a month or two
author: c(O_o)3

title: Excellent focus tool
body: I work in IT and often find myself working on big projects that require lots of seat time. The “music” that Brain.fm creates is excellent at keeping me focused and on task. Would definitely recommend using with headphones/earbuds that have some kind of sound isolation.
author: Awesumsawz

title: Good app although expensive
body: Helps me focus
author: Mkfarris

title: It Actually Helps Me Concentrate, Stay On Task
body: I am a paid subscriber; I’ve never had connectivity issues. This app actually helps me stay on task and concentrate well. It helps to keep me focused to work through projects. I primarily use the focus function and they have added several new tracks to the list over the few years I have consistently used the app.
author: StevOmg

title: Awesome App!
body: This app is my “go-to” to get stuff done and focus. Instead of listening to music on Pandora or Spotify while I work, now I turn this on and am able to tune everything else out. I primarily use the focus tracks, but the Nap and Relax ones are great too. Unlike other reviews, I have experienced ZERO connectivity issues. Well worth the year subscription!

title: Great for focus... when it works
body:
I have had some streaming issues with the app to keep music playing during better after I 
re-downloaded it was better.

title: Every day
body: I use this every single day to work in noisy environments and I’ve never had any trouble with it. I really love this app.
author: Psmdtg

title: I have no idea how this works, but it helps
body: I’ve always had a hard time falling asleep. Listening to this seems to calm my mind and let me drop off. Been using the focus part at work too. Seems to help with the afternoon slump.
author: ConBrio78

title: You have come along way
body:
I started to use Brain.fm a couple of years ago. I almost exclusively use the focus to enhance my focus and work performance. It is better than caffeine.

The design has finally caught up. No more web based application for me. No more beta.

A great application that keeps on giving.
author: Throtol

title: Needs more options
body: I love love this app! My only complaint is that there are not more time options in the nap and meditation functions: in the nap function there should be 1hr and 1.5hr options, in meditation there should be 15 minute increments up to an hour or 1.5 hours.
author: babyZENmama

title: Some issues but highly effective
body:
Connectivity problems sometimes and can be a bit wonky when comnexting to bluetooth.   Seems to be more reliable of late.   I am a paid subscriber.

Focus -  have found it very effective.   I am usually playing it 4-6 hours a day but notice an effext within 20 min.

Sleep -  has not worked well, but my sons seems to be more in tune with it

Meditation -  very effective.  Have used it to meditate in the car (i have a driver).    I fee it makes getting into the zone easier when using at home.

Overall i would highly recommend
author: krishChiv

title: Customized session length
body: I enjoy the app, but would really like to be able to customize the session length.  The current options are not granular enough.
author: BHmax12

title: One of my staples
body: I use this app every day at work and sometimes at home. This is one of those staple apps that I’m not sure how I got by before it was created. I mostly use the focus music, but the meditation music is amazing as well. I just wish there were some more comfortable headphones on the market to listen to the sleep and nap music.
author: lathibad

title: Truly remarkable!
body: I have been using Brain.fm for several months. I have used it for focus, sleep, and meditation. I find them all to be effective. I like to download the songs, because I have limited bandwidth and can’t support streaming all the time. I find that when listening to a sleep soundtrack I would wake up and the music would have stopped. I wish that the download tracks for focus would be longer then 30 minutes. I am aware of the 25 min on 5 min off concept, so maybe that was taken into play with the short length of the downloads. The app really does do wonders for concentration, meditation, and sleep. Overall, I would highly recommend.
author: bkitchen07

title: Literally saved me from losing my job
body: ADD makes it difficult to focus at work, but when it gets particularly bad I force myself to use this app and it’s like it turns on a focus switch in my brain. Thanks guys!!
author: Baxter522

title: Awesome
body: I love Brain.fm-great to focus with while at work and great guided meditation. Listen to this everyday!
author: davidryther

title: Great app!!
body: I have been using Brain.fm for the past several months - the focus channel works amazingly well.
author: MikeD12@

title: Perfect
body: Love it all. Wish they would add workout music too.
author: SamanFakhreddin

title: Be prepared to pay.. a lot
body: Very nice app that works well. It will work for a few times, then want you to pay $50+ a year. That was a bit letdown, especially since it quit working half way through the night.
author: A Earhart

title: It flat out works
body:
Brain.FM 100%, absolutely works. Within minutes of listening to a specific track, you begin to notice the effects. What I mean by that is when you listen to a track intended to help you focus, your brain will begin to do just that allowing you to be more productive. And it’s not just enhancing your already focused brain, you could be completely out of it and by listening to a track, reframe your state of mind to be focused! 
Yes, the app has its faults and areas to be improved but these mainly come down to minor annoyances. The product is stellar and completely out weighs any app issues.
author: P_Lew23

title: Connectivity and Bluetooth problems
body: I love this app and use all the modes. I’ve been having issue with it halting my playback in my AirPods while the tracks continue to play, no audio in my headphones. Also connectivity issues, buffering will just stop and not pick back up. Needs some tech/big updates, I’ve noticed a positive impact on both my focus and sleep.
author: CAM_Bam_0000

title: Game changer!
body: I first heard about this app on podcast. Tried the focus in the morning and was blown away. I have a hard time reading longer then 30 minutes, now with Brain.FM I can read as long as I need. My only complaint is that I am late for work because I get too focused and lose track of time :-) Strongly suggest trying this app!!!
author: Rowan the boat

title: Great, but connection seems horrible
body: Fix the connectivity issues and I will resubscribe and rate 5 stars. Love the app but connection simply isn’t consistent enough.
author: Jkokoski

title: Wow!
body: I love brain.fm it really helps calm you down after a long workout, meditation, or just a short nap.
author: N8CHOLAS

title: Great concept, lacking execution
body: When the app works properly it awesome. I genuinely feel a difference in focus and relaxation when listening to the music. Despite the bugs in the software I still use it daily. This company should probably hire some new devs though because there are just unacceptable issues with the software. Biggest problem is just the app randomly pausing, then having to open it back up and start playing it again. Also offline mode is pretty weird. Some of the songs that I have downloaded don’t seem to be available through the explore menu. So somewhere there is a disconnect in categorization. I get the idea of designing an app to be stupid simple but I need just a bit more control over things. Maybe I’d like to relax more than 30 minutes. So I think it’s a worthwhile download for the content rather than the lacking app experience.
author: athebear

title: Like the tracks, but connectivity issues are nonstop
body:
I exclusively use the focus tracks, and consistently have had connectivity problems. Sometimes it won’t start up at all, and often it cuts out in the middle of a track.

I really do think these are helpful, but the connectivity issue is starting to become a real point of frustration.
author: Boum987

title: User for almost a year
body: It gets my work mojo going when I need the extra boost. I also use it for relaxation and meditation but the sleep feature doesn't quite work for me.
author: Mubblefubbles!

title: Really Works
body: Gets the brain in focus mode for building financial plans better than vitamin B. When I need a rest, 15 minuted relax is great. I sleep well however, have used the sleep when traveling and it works.... I normally do not sleep well in hotels. FYI: In 2 years of daily use, NEVER had a connection issue that was not related to local WiFi or bad cell reception. I think people are a little ignorant as this is a streaming app and it should not be blamed for poor reception.
author: GrouperKing

title: Amazing app
body: I was introduced to this app by a podcast called Mind Pump Media. I figured I would give it a try because I’m fascinated by meditation and I like to explore different tools to help me in doing so. The first time I tried this app I loved it. The guided meditations are wonderful and there are a lot of different songs to pick from across all mental state options. I recommend this app to anyone from a beginner to a seasoned practitioner. Great app!
author: CJPruz

title: Awesome!
body: Brain.fm has helped my focus and sleep so much. It’s a game changer.
author: JDMulholland

title: It works!!
body: I have ADHD and sometimes it can be hard to focus on one task at a time at work so when I need it, I use this and it works.
author: galangsternation

title: Awesome
body: I almost always have my headphones in while I’m working. I would get distracted and lose my train of thought when I’d listen to some songs as I would sing along with the lyrics. Due to the distractions I would run into while listening to my favorite artists or the Top 100 playlist, I started to look at different types of music, music without any lyrics. I was listening to a Mind Pump podcast with the CEO Dan Clark and was sold. I use brain.fm all the time while working, now. Definitely recommend!
author: mfawc4

title: Great for focus, meditation, and sleep.
body: It helps everything. For sleeping, a comfortable head band type of head phones is essential though.
author: Nick Ortego

title: Does great!
body: The focus music always helps me get homework and studying done when their are distractions around. The meditation is great for learning to meditate and understanding how to relax. And the sleep works better then sleep aids when trying to get a nights rest in a loud environment. I have an average of 2.5mbps download speed and never have any problems buffering in the daily usage of this app.
author: H4xar

title: Amazing app!
body: I heard about this app on a podcast and tried the demo. Wow. I was skeptical at first until I used it at work and again at home when I was going to sleep. It took a bit for me to “notice” its effect but I was feeling like I was in the zone I guess.  The sleep side was awesome too. Crashed right out. Now I use the paid edition and it’s a daily thing now. Highly recommend!
author: momentumjosh

title: Really pleased with the results
body: I recently purchased the annual Brain.fm subscription and have found myself using it at work regularly, and finding myself able to focus more intensely in a cubicle style workplace than I ever have before! It has really helped to cut out the distraction of the office while allowing me to write code at a much more efficient pace! Would highly recommend everyone try the free trial to see if you get similar results
author: Alaskan4Life

title: Great new update
body: The new piano focus channel is really great.
author: Al8one25

title: Constant pausing and buffering
body:
The soundscapes are very effective for me, when they work. 

The constant issues I have with the app pausing for no reason, then having to resume it manually pretty much ruins the whole experience and breaks my focus. I have tried downloading some tracks, but they often freeze in the middle of downloading. 

The app has a lot of hugs and issues, but the product is great. I've switched to using the web version on my laptop when I'm using it while working, and only use the iOS app sparingly because of how bugged it is.
author: Arick Conley

title: Amazing
body: Really works
author: GNick727

title: Skeptical turned Believer in ONE Session
body: I can’t say enough, this app is great just for the focus sessions but is so much more. I heard about it on mindpump and figured I’d give it a try. My first focus session started good and the next time I looked up an hour had passed and I had cleared my to do list for the morning. Give it a try, you won’t be disappointed.
author: Craneguy32

title: Best nap-sleep-meditation nap ever
body: Love this app for for taking power naps and meditations. And I actually use the meditation tracks for my power naps - they seem to work even better for me...
author: Keithkranc

title: Worth Every Penny
body: I’ve always had a hard time focusing with any type of background noise (conversation, TV, even music). The binaural beats combined with pleasantly textured repetitive music in this app do two things for me: 1. blocks out distractions, and 2. Melts into back of my mind (so I almost don’t actively know it’s there) and allows my brain to focus entirely on whatever I want. It’s done wonders for me during work, meditation, and sleep. I used to wake up at the slightest sound, now I sleep solidly through the night. It is a very surreal experience and waking up almost feels like coming back from a long relaxing trip to another world. I bought the lifetime subscription. It’s the most I’ve ever paid for a single app but it’s paid itself off in multiple different ways.
author: Dmonson

title: Actually works
body: This is my secret weapon at work!
author: adegollado

title: Noticeably effective ambient music
body: Love what these people have done and the app is very simple and inuitive to use.  Favorite feature is that you can download tracks for offline later (like in an airplane), but would love to see the Home page separate out intense focus and relaxed focus.
author: Geemonroe

title: Great app
body: Perfect for students
author: Joeack99

title: Very very good. Wish for...
body:
I wish that it have offline capabilities or that it had a 15 minute buffer or so when you get into an area that has limited or no connectivity. 

Wish it had a little bit more choice.  Like maybe something geared towards different types of focus or meditation. 

Lastly, the timer could be more flexible.  But still with quick access buttons.
author: Bryant Smith

title: Love it, but...
body: This app is great and helpful, but connectivity problems can be a real drag
author: Eyeaches

title: Great for the whole family!
body: I use for work, to take power naps and to fall asleep at night! My kids use it to focus on HW and wind down at night!
author: jportheber

title: Effective - but not all AI-generated
body:
I love this app. The selections are terrific, and I believe the Focus selections I’ve used helped me finish my last book in record time. 
I only have one gripe: that the creators claim the music is all generated by AI. That’s not true. I’ve been playing some of these piano pieces for 30 years. Brain.fm’s AI may be working with music that’s now in the public domain, but it’s not 100% AI-generated content. Just sayin’.
author: Byabz

title: Solid App but value questionable
body: Maybe it’s just me but it feels like a lot of the same stuff over and over. I usually only listen to focus and meditation tracks. Value of this questionable as a lot of this type of music can be found online for free. I will say it’s effective and I use it a lot at work and on planes when I want to focus on something.
author: Big rales

title: Awesome app
body: I use this app every day, usually while reading on mass transit or at work, and I’ve noticed a definite improvement in my ability to stay focused.
author: A British Druid

title: I enjoy this app

title: Great for zoning out at work and for sleep!
body: It's the only type of sleeping music that can lull me to sleep. 👍
author: HDIron

title: Connectivity issues
body: I am a paid subscriber and really like the product. The catch is with the delivery. Like many reviewers, I am experiencing significant connectivity issues that must be addressed in order justifying the price. Frustrating. title: Outstanding
body:
I’ve being a user since the beginning and found their customer service outstanding. 

This app has made a huge difference not only at work, but also when I need to relax and calm down at home.
author: swanbep

title: Long-time user, highly recommend
body: I was very skeptical, as I find most of this sort of stuff to be rubbish. But I’ve used Brain.fm since the early days, and I love it. I’ve found it to be consistently useful and helpful. I use “focus” for work and sleep, actually, as I have ADHD. Often, the ADHD brain simply can’t settle down or “focus” to go to sleep. I highly recommend trying out Brain.fm. I’m a lifelong member, and I wouldn’t trade it for any of the competition.

body: I use this app almost everyday, the focus and sleep feature. The focus feature works extremely well for me. The sleep one in flight is more effective with earphones on.

I love the app, but the connectivity/offline issues need attention!

It sounded like I was going to move from one song to the next (faded out), but nothing faded back in. I’m also an ADHD kid and use this app exclusively on exam days, so losing sound for no reason is a pretty big deal. I love the app to death, just wish it didn’t have this issue!

title: So great!
body: This is one of the best brain waves app that I’ve used so far. I just wish that when you paid to download something. It was per song so I could keep it. I get on the plane, put my headphones in and crank out all my emails and work. Makes me so productive. I use it in the office too. Really keeps me focused. Love this app!

title: Connectivity is great

I use this app every single day and have never noticed anything wrong with it. It is an awesome app and I would recommend it to anyone who is looking to get in the zone :) or to sleep/meditate.

author: KAMCan0903

title: Great for working in large open office plans
body: I use brain fm primarily at work when I need to get involved in some deep focus heads down work and tune out all of the activity around me (open office plan with about 50 busy colleagues chatting, moving, and meeting all around me). The focus playlists really do an amazing job of helping to drown out all the noise around me without distracting me like music can. White noise always missed the mark for me, but this is perfect. I’ve also listened to the relax playlists when I’m heading to work or winding down after or preping to go into an upcoming meeting that I know will be stressful. Definitely helps get me in a better headspace. And lastly I use the focus or relax playlists also when reading on my commute to drown out passenger and traffic noises (on bus or train). The one failing is the downloadable function which rarely works to allow you play offline.

author: Trillian19

title: Service issues, company doesn’t care.
body: Perpetually dropping the stream, regardless of whether I use a browser on a PC (3 different Browsers, in fact). iPhone, Bluetooth or wired. They have bad connectivity problems that the company doesn’t seem to care about. I am a paying customer who will definitely not be renewing. Every time I’ve emailed support, I get a blow-off reply of, “oh, we haven’t heard of any problems. What browser and OS are you using.” Obviously from the reviews, they’re just lying. My guess is that  brain.fm has been so profitable that they just don’t care about customer retention. I can’t figure it out, but whatever. I don’t have time for BS like their support dishes out. I’ll move on to a better service instead. I gave them at least 2 or 3 opportunities to address my issues and they failed every time. The web site claimed “new songs are constantly being added.” This is not true. I’ve never heard a single new song. The “offline mode” only allows you to download a 30 minute track, which is useless for just about any application that I can think of. I wonder if the people responsible for this app ever bother using their own product. I can’t imagine that they do, because they would have noticed all of these problems and fixed them. I don’t understand. I wanted to love this app, but when a company lets me down as hard as brain.fm has, there’s just no way that I can. Whatever success you’ve had up to now will quickly be eroded by your sub-par technical support (and the way you just blow off quality issues). Good riddance.

I mostly use this app for focus at work when I’m trying to get the work done. It seems to work for me. I do feel more in the flow and focused when using. I’ve been using binaural beats in form for many years now. So maybe I’m just tuned to that?

title: Indispensable
body:
Longtime subscriber. Huge fan, bordering on dependency, thanks to its effectiveness in helping me manage my attention and get things done.
 
I am a heavy user: during 10-15min zazen meditation sessions each morning, then several hours' worth to focus during work. I'm a software developer and "mind hacks / life hacks" type of person, have tried countless other apps and processes and tools, and for me nothing else comes close to this (along w/ 7h sleep, daily meditation, and use of a bullet journal). YMMV but for me Brain FM is the gold standard for managing mental state through audio.

PS Had some temp connectivity issues as of my upgrade to iOS 11.2, but they were completely resolved by removing the app and doing a fresh install (v2.45.2.35) from the app store.

author: NurseSC

title: Helps a lot for Focus; Nap/Sleep: less so
body: It’s very useful to have 30 min-2 hrs of Focused work. And for a 45 min or shorter Nap, it’s not bad — but I wish it allowed more time choices or the ability to set a duration beyond the defaults. Sometimes I wake up and need to fall back asleep for a couple hours. Sometimes I need a 1.5 or 2-hr Nap. But I find my binaural apps/tracks work better for sleep anyway, so I return to those to really conk out. (Some of those also use a slowing rate of pulses or beats to entrain and slow the mind, which may be why they can be more powerful for deeper sleep.) Pro-tip: The Brain.fm for a 30-min Focus session works pretty well as a Wake session.
author: Yonkers-Man

title: Don’t waste time. Get Brain.fm and leverage Deep Work.
body: This is by far the best focus/sleep audio tool you can find. I DO NOT like to listen to music - even instrumental - when I’m working as I feel it detracts from my focus. Brain.fm is the only alternative to silence that supports my efforts. I write, create, design, coach, and teach at a post-grad level, and I need uninterrupted attention when engaging those activities. Brain.fm helps me stay in the “zone” or “flow state” while I work. It also has helped me get to sleep - just don’t forget to set an alarm or make the “play” duration shorter, because it can be that effective. You won’t be disappointed with this software.

author: HomerJ

title: Lame, Deceptive, Bait and Switch
body:
Beware: This is really just a monthly paid service for access to some songs/sounds. You're much better off with a paid subscription to Spotify Premium. Lame. 

Before using the app, it forces you to create a login with password and provide your email. Why?! 

Once you've given them your information, only then do they reveal -- surprise! -- that you have a limited number of uses of the app, and you need to sign up for a recurring monthly or yearly charge to your account to continue using the service. 

What a waste of time downloading. Extremely frustrating and invasive. Apple should strictly prohibit this kind of bad faith, bait-and-switch sales tactic in the App Store.
author: SD photo geek

title: Simple and effective
body:
Seems like a lot of apps today want to be everything to everyone. They have feature after feature after feature, and the whole thing is either overly complex, half broken, or both.

title: Best in class for focus and more
body:
This is the best in the world for what it does, and I have confidence that it will continue to be in the future. I am a lifetime subscriber and recommend you be, if you find the trial effective. Try focusatwill / focus@will before you decide to buy this, especially if you need more relaxed focus than this product gives you. I like green tea as my favorite stimulant for focus, and I also drink coffee some days, including espresso. I would recommend that you definitely compare to the more relaxed focus settings on focus@will first if you avoid and can't handle espresso, but I am not sensitive to caffeine. The brain.fm web portal is less buggy than the focus@will one, and you don't need to be dealing with software bugs when you're trying to focus.

I've found nothing that compares to brain.fm and had listened to binaural beats for years prior to trying this. The most effective for me is the focus setting. The relax and meditation settings, which have a bit of difference in naming between the app and web portal, work very well, but they are not as competitively superior to binaural beats in this application. If you like ASMR, the relax settings do not trigger that response for me. The sleep setting is not effective for me, but it works wonders for a coworker who is also a lifetime subscriber. He wakes up just as the session is ending. The focus and mental clarity I get from this are unrivaled, and it works perfectly with nootropics such as noopept and phenylpiracetam.

I got the lifetime subscription after a one month paid trial, and I recommend this subscription option to anyone who finds a trial session very effective. Everything else is comparatively a rip off, and the lifetime subscription currently costs half of the focus@will price. They are always improving the app and the quality of the music generated and have indicated that they will continue to in the future. They show no sign of backing off the bleeding edge of the science of this that they have stayed on since starting the product. I recommend this to everyone, and I would buy a subscription as a gift for a friend who tried and liked it. You can't beat this product. Hands down winner.

title: Great concept and effect, but app needs work
body:

Building that association between the music and being productive really helps, even if you're unsure about the science of the entrainment effect.

The app needs a lot of work however. The music will stop unexpectedly if you don't have great wifi, the offline mode only stores 30 minutes sessions (for the most part), and there's not really a great navigation experience in the app. Sometimes I'll get stuck in a screen and have to force quit. The timer will reset unexpectedly if the audio cuts off.

Why does it need to stream anyways? I get that it's procedurally generated with AI, but I wouldn't be offended if it was pre-rendered and cached. Just store some amount of audio, maybe overnight when on wifi.

I bought a lifetime membership, I would love to be able to export the audio as an MP3 to play on other devices.

title: Great Technology, Poor Implementation and Functionality
body:
I appreciate your technology and mission and want to use it and subscribe, but the app is very frustrating to use. The aesthetic is pleasing, but the functionality is challenging enough that app is not user friendly. Offline use and lack of coherence are principle problems, but there are numerous bugs and oversights:

- Sleep tracks never play in their entirety, e.g. seven hours, and when trying to rectify this in the middle of the night, rarely is balance of time accurately reflected. Could say something weird like 14 hours or 15 minutes like it’s a nap track.
- Offline use is critical for this app, for health and functional reasons. Since any track I like is likely to be downloaded for offline use—using while in Airplane mode when sleeping—it’s very difficult to accurately identify tracks I like. Wait, associated image is supposed to help. Well, too often image is duplicated so it’s not actually differentiating track. So the procedure is very cumbersome: listen to each unidentified track, try to remember which one I like based on sound, then find it again to download all the while realizing that I’m not sure if it is the right one since sound of some tracks are remarkably similar. Assign it a number or name (I’d argue for former) and I’ll rename it later if I don’t like your choice.
- Better, after I choose time, seven hours, provide a list with play/sample option to hear individual offerings but don’t abandon context. With a list, I know I’m listening to 1 of 5 options within sleep. With current design, I have no idea where I am in your library. This is compounded with Explore. Are these tracks the same as what’s in Mental State? Who knows.
- If nothing more, give them numbers so returning to preferred track to download for offline use is easy.
- Bug: if I sample a track in Mental State, sleep for example, then press back arrow Mental State list, track continues to play (which is fine), but without force quitting app, I no longer have control over audio. There is no play, pause button to stop track in this view.
- The main problem is inattention to context: user doesn’t know which track of total offered within category they’re hearing and it’s too difficult to accurately distinguish any given track for future use.

I know you’re technology has health value and benefits, but I’m not convinced I’ll resubscribe as current design is too nebulous and even confounding at times. Please address.

title: Very useful app that works well.
body:
I've been using the app for about a month, daily, and enjoy it more and more.  I use it for focus (I'm a firmware engineer, lots of time writing code and designing electronics) and it helps me focus.  2 hours goes by like a blink.  That's the main reason I bought the app.

Since buying the app, I found uses that I hadn't anticipated.  The "sleep" mode (6/7/8 hours) is really perfect for the kind of drone / wash that I like to fall asleep to.  No more Spotify, now it's Brain.fm with a small Bluetooth speaker.  Also the "nap" choices are great, lots of times I'm traveling (flying) and a 30-minute nap is much better now.  I think I fall asleep in under 5 minutes now.

2 other features that I discovered, that many might not be aware of: if you like a selection, you can download it (save offline) and play even when you're untethered (e.g. on a plane, out of range, etc.)  The other feature that I went weeks w/o discovering is the "Explore" feature.  Previously I thought there was 1 selection for focus, 1 for relaxing, and 1 for sleeping/napping.  But no!  There are many different variations for each.   (Hamburger menu -> Explore). My favorite Focus is "Relaxed Focus", and my favorite "Relax" is "Ambient Music."

Last thing -- it works.  It backed by science -- just go to the app's website and read up.  These guys know what they're doing.

My /only/ request/suggestion is when saving offline (downloading), it would be nice to be able to name the saved selections.

title: Broken subscription system
body:
[Update]
Within a few hours after writing to Brain.fm's customer support, they resolved my subscription issue and I've been utterly in love with the service ever since. In fact, it has become part of my daily workflow process to help me concentrate on my tasks. Can't recommend this service enough. 

I was very excited to see Brain.fm's new iOS app and immediately signed up for a year subscription. Unfortunately, the app hangs every time I try to activate it (including attempting to restore my purchase). So, I'm stuck with a subscription that I paid $49 for and cannot use.

I'll gladly revise my review once the issue is fixed (which hopefully is soon).
author: Brian Matiash

title: Hands down the best brain hack
body: I've been using brain.fm for a year now on their website patiently waiting for this app to release. It is everything I could have asked for and more. These guys are pushing the technology and science behind brain wave entrainment. It's like binaural beats on steroids. I can focus in minutes for reading. My favorite uses are for meditation and napping. Excellent product already and they're aren't stopping here! This is the future!!

title: Cannot use paid features
body: I tried to subscribe and just get a spinning circle forever. I've been looking forward to this app for a while for offline use, I've now had to ask for a refund.

title: Subtle but amazing focus
body: This has been a game changer for me. I love music but I write a lot of various messages for my job and lyrics distract me. Ambient was fine but I get bored. Brain.fm engages my brain while not distracting me from the task at hand. Brilliant company that I'd be devastated if they disappeared tomorrow.
author: ScarmbleBuddy

title: Truly amazing
body: Brain.fm is the cure for my ADD. I can't imagine living or working without it now. It gets me into a focused state almost instantly, and sincerely increases my quality of life. 10/10, you need this.
